testPlan.title: Frontend automated test plan
testPlan.description: Automated frontend tests for app launch, auth, navigation, lobby, gameplay, playback and imports.

steps.title: App launches to Welcome screen
steps.description: Verify app launch and welcome UI

steps.title: User login flow (AuthContext)
steps: Expect: successful login and navigation to MenuScreen

steps.title: Menu navigation to Lobby and Settings
steps.description: Navigate from menu to lobby and settings and verify persistence
steps: Open Settings and change a setting, then return

steps.title: Lobby flow: join/create game
steps.description: Create or join a game room and verify player list
steps: On LobbyScreen, create a game or join existing
Expect: game created and players list updates
Start game button enabled when enough players

steps.title: Game play: song selection & timer
steps.description: Play a round and validate choices, timer and scoring
steps: Expect: track choices rendered, timer counts down
Select an answer and verify scoring behavior

steps.title: Reveal & GameOver sequence
steps.description: Validate reveal screen and game over flow
steps: Complete round and navigate to RevealScreen
Expect: reveal content shows correct info

steps.title: Music playback: start/stop and autoplay handling
steps.description: Ensure playback starts, pauses and persists across background
steps: When returning to background, ensure playback state preserved

steps.title: Profile import (Deezer/Spotify)
steps.description: Import profile or tracks from Deezer/Spotify
steps: Expect: imported tracks or profile data shown

steps.title: Error handling: network / Firebase failures
steps.description: Simulate failures and check app resilience
steps: Expect: ErrorBoundary / Toast shows appropriate message, app doesn't crash

extraTestCases.title: App Settings Toggles Haptics Behavior
extraTestCases.description: Verify that toggling haptics in settings enables/disables haptic feedback

steps.description: Perform user actions that produce haptic feedback.

extraTestCases.title: App Settings Toggles Control Sound Effects
extraTestCases.description: Verify that enabling/disabling sound effects affects in-game and UI sounds

steps.description: Open SettingsScreen and disable sound effects toggle.
Perform UI interactions and gameplay actions that produce sound.
